author: GamingBolt
description:
For Bethesda Game Studios, their reputation has never tumbled as low as CD Projekt's. But, for a studio once untouchable in the RPG space – the developer behind genre-defining staples like Fallout 3 and Skyrim – they’ve spent the better part of the last decade navigating uneven ground. In an era marked by development missteps and shifting priorities, there’s a sense that BSG has lost its touch. 

And this is what makes Starfield’s impending PS5 launch so significant. Whilst the game has fans (there’s a lot to like, after all) it’s fair to say Bethesda’s space-faring RPG didn’t fully land. In some ways, it’s still riding through turbulence despite Bethesda’s post-launch support.
title: Say What You Will About Starfield, Its PS5 Release Could Be Huge

author: GamingBolt
description:
Crimson Desert’s story feels like an odd patchwork of narrative threads that are certainly compelling on their own, but fail to weave a bigger picture that manages to bring them all together. But how could a game that spent ages in development, and presents an otherwise solid experience, manage to produce a story that’s so disjointed?

That’s even more important in the face of side content that goes from strength to strength as you dive into the various quest chains that open up. Well, we’re here to look into what went wrong, backed up by statements from the developer and Kliff’s voice actor in a rather regretful look at a story that sacrificed its potential on the altar of the game’s own ambitions. 

Join us as we take a look at why Crimson Desert’s story failed to hit the notes that the rest of the experience manages to achieve.

Thumbnail credit: nexusmod user: Nostyx
title: What The Hell Happened To Crimson Desert's Story?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Hype can be harnessed to build anticipation and fuel expectation. However, it can, sometimes, set games up for a fall even before the first player has loaded in. 

Whether its bold thematic shifts, technical shortcomings, or simply failing to live up to promises, even the biggest names and the strongest pedigree can get it wrong. So, from long-awaited sequels, to ambitious reboots and genre forbearers, here are twelve more games which couldn’t meet expectations.
title: 12 Single Player Games That Had GOTY Hype And Blew It
